TWO LANES · SAME MODEL AS SAKURA / PANDUAGENT

Pick your lane

SonoWaves now uses the same payment model as Sakura and PanduAGENT on BNB Chain: the free mint is Agent ID-only — one free wave per Agent ID, claimed through the Binance Agentic Wallet. Paid mints are public: anyone with an EVM wallet and BNB can mint, no Agent ID needed.

Free Lane — Agent ID Only

The first 2,260 waves are free — 1 free mint per Agent ID, claimed via mintFree() through the Binance Agentic Wallet. You only pay the tiny BNB gas. First come, first served, until the free pool is gone.

  • Mint #1 per wallet — FREE, Agent ID holders only
  • Free pool — 2,260 waves total
  • Binance Agentic Wallet + SPACE ID Agent ID required
  • Free mints earn no SONO bonus

Read the agent skill → · Go to the Priority Lane ↓

Paid Lane — 0.0007 BNB · Public

After your free mint — or once the free pool runs out — paid waves cost a flat 0.0007 BNB via mintPaid(). Paid minting is public: any EVM wallet can mint, no Agent ID required — the same split Sakura and PanduAGENT use.

  • Paid pool — 4,406 waves
  • Flat 0.0007 BNB per wave
  • Bonus — 12,000 SONO per paid mint
  • Up to 10 paid per wallet
  • Max 11 per wallet total — 1 free + 10 paid

See the mint box ↓

FOUR TIERS · ONE FUSE LADDER

The tiers

Every wave starts as sound on water. Tier 1 is minted — the higher tiers are reached by fusing: burn 3 waves of one tier, receive 1 of the next. No luck, no gambling — the ladder is fixed and public.

Drop Tone
TIER 1 · COMMON
The single drop. Minted directly — free lane and paid lane both land here.
Ripple Chord
TIER 2 · RARE
Three ripples in harmony. Fuse 3 × Drop Tone → 1 × Ripple Chord.
Wave Harmony
TIER 3 · EPIC
Layered waves in full flow. Fuse 3 × Ripple Chord → 1 × Wave Harmony.
Tide Boom
TIER 4 · LEGENDARY
The tidal peak. Fuse 3 × Wave Harmony → 1 × Tide Boom. 27 base waves make one.

How the fuse ladder works

Burn 3 waves of the same tier and the contract mints you 1 wave of the next tier — deterministic, anyone holding waves can fuse, no randomness involved. Fused waves are new token IDs above the 6,666 mint supply.

3 × Drop Tone→1 × Ripple Chord→3 × that→1 × Wave Harmony→1 × Tide Boom
BONUS TOKEN · PAID MINTS ONLY

The SONO bonus

Every paid mint earns a bonus of 12,000 SONO — the collection's bonus token. Free mints earn no bonus. With at most 10 paid mints per wallet, the most one wallet can earn is 120,000 SONO.

SONO is a mint bonus only — earned by paid minting, never sold separately by this project, and carrying no promise of value. The SONO contract is not deployed yet; its address will be published here, next to the NFT contract address, after deploy.

FOUR STEPS

How it works

1

Get your Agent ID (for the free mint)

The free mint is Agent ID-only. Set up the Binance Agentic Wallet and register a SPACE ID Agent ID — that Agent ID is what mintFree() checks on-chain. No Agent ID? Skip to paid minting — paid is public for everyone.

2

Add BNB Smart Chain + fund BNB

In MetaMask, Rabby, or your wallet, add the network from the Network section below — Chain ID 56, symbol BNB. Gas on BNB Chain is paid in BNB; a small amount — 0.01–0.02 BNB — is plenty of headroom for minting, since BSC gas is very cheap. No bridging needed.

3

Mint your wave

When mint opens: Agent ID holders claim 1 free mint via the Binance Agentic Wallet (2,260-wave pool), then paid waves are public at a flat 0.0007 BNB and each one earns 12,000 SONO bonus, up to 11 per wallet in total. The artwork for your token is visible at mint — no delayed reveal.

4

Fuse up the ladder

Hold your waves, trade them, or fuse 3 → 1 to climb: Drop Tone → Ripple Chord → Wave Harmony → Tide Boom. Creator royalty is 5% on secondary sales.

COMING SOON — AFTER MINT OPENS

Trading opens once waves exist

The marketplace is the last launch step, not the first. It will be deployed and linked here only after the NFT contract is live and mint has opened — until then, this section is a placeholder with nothing to buy, sell, or connect to.

How it will work

  • Holders list their minted waves for sale in BNB
  • Buyers pay in BNB on BNB Smart Chain (Chain ID 56), same wallet as minting
  • Secondary sales carry the 5% creator royalty already published on this page
  • Fused higher-tier waves (Ripple Chord, Wave Harmony, Tide Boom) trade the same way

Watch out: any “SonoWaves marketplace” link circulating before it is announced on this page is not official. The real link will be published here, next to the NFT contract address, after deploy.

QUESTIONS

FAQ

Which wallet do I need?

For paid mints: any EVM wallet on BNB Smart Chain — MetaMask, Rabby, Bitget Wallet, or Trust Wallet. For the free mint: the Binance Agentic Wallet with a registered SPACE ID Agent ID — the free lane is Agent ID-only, exactly like Sakura and PanduAGENT.

How does the free mint work?

The free mint is Agent ID-only: 1 free wave per Agent ID, claimed via mintFree() through the Binance Agentic Wallet while the 2,260-wave free pool lasts — the same model as Sakura and PanduAGENT. There is no direct free-mint button on this page: you claim it only by pasting the Priority Lane agent prompt in the Mint section into your Binance Agentic Wallet. Paid mints are public — anyone can mint at 0.0007 BNB via mintPaid(), no Agent ID needed.

What do I pay gas in?

BNB. SonoWaves runs on BNB Smart Chain (56), so every mint and trade pays gas in BNB. Paid mints cost a flat 0.0007 BNB each plus that small gas fee.

When does mint open?

Not yet — the contract is not deployed. The remaining steps are in the launch checklist above. When a date is set, it will be announced in UTC on the official X, @Sonofluidic, and this page will show the live contract address.

Where is the marketplace?

It does not exist yet. The NFT collection — 6,666 waves in four tiers — is defined on this page, but no marketplace contract has been deployed and there are no listings. The marketplace is the final launch step, after mint opens; its official link will be published in the Marketplace section. Treat any marketplace link shared elsewhere before then as unofficial.

Is there a bonus token?

Yes — SONO. Every paid mint earns 12,000 SONO. Free mints earn no bonus, and with at most 10 paid mints per wallet the bonus caps at 120,000 SONO per wallet. There is no separate airdrop — SONO is earned by paid minting only, and the token is not deployed yet.
